summary: This bill directs the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to present a Congressional Gold Medal to the American hostages and victims of the October 7, 2023, attacks, recognizing their suffering and sacrifice, and authorizes the Secretary of the Treasury to strike and sell bronze duplicates.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes the striking of a Congressional Gold Medal and duplicate bronze medals, with costs to be charged against the United States Mint Public Enterprise Fund. While this involves government expenditure, it is a minor, one-time cost for a symbolic award, not a significant spending program.
